reviews.review_description: It has a nostalgic feel, reminding me of games from childhood, which made it a pleasant experience to play.

reviews.review_title: Jump that ball to the finish
reviews.review_description:
Bloop! is a fun VR puzzle game. It is smooth and easy to pick up. 

It becomes more challenging as you progress, keeping things fresh and engaging. Whether you’re new to VR or a seasoned player, this is a great game that’s definitely worth playing. Highly recommended! 

And the first world (33 levels), is free to play.
